name: Malta

related_people.name: Julius
related_people.role: the centurion who spared the prisoners after the shipwreck on this island

related_people.name: Publius
related_people.role: the island's chief man, whose father Paul healed of fever and dysentery

description: The island where Paul's ship ran aground during the storm-tossed voyage to Rome; Paul was unharmed by a viper's bite there and healed the island's chief official, Publius's, sick father (Acts 28:1-10).
